text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) study on dairy systems. While it incorporates land use change (LUC) predictions from global economic models (GTAP, LEITAP) as an *input* to assess environmental impacts, the paper's primary focus is not on *spatially explicit LULC prediction* itself. It fails the core inclusion criteria: 1) It does not implement a national-scale spatial LULC prediction model; 2) Its central research question is the environmental impact of a farming system switch, not LULC prediction; 3) It lacks spatial modeling with quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC maps. The LUC data are derived from external models for use in an LCA calculation.)
